lines.t: Verse 1
The evening light falls softly on my face
And everything feels quieter with You
My eyes fill with tears of joy as I think of all You've done
Of all the times You pulled me through
Pre-Chorus
My heart burns with passion when I hear Your name
Chorus
I will always remember that You love me
I will always remember You're here
I will always remember Your promise
Until the day You call me near
My heart longs for the home You've prepared
Where I'll finally see You so clear
Verse 2
Sometimes I sit and think about that day
When You take me to that place You've prepared.
And though You've always been so close beside me
My heart still longs for when I'll see You there
Pre-Chorus 2
And every time I think about that day
My soul is filled with wonder in every way
Chorus
I will always remember that You love me
I will always remember You're here
I will always remember Your promise
Until the day You call me near
My heart longs for the home You've prepared
Where I'll finally see You so clear
Bridge
Somewhere beyond the years and all my questions
Beyond the days and everything I've known
There's a moment waiting for me in Your presence
And somehow, even now, it feels like home
Final Chorus
I will always remember that You love me
I will always remember You're here
I will always remember Your promise
Until the day You call me near
My heart burns for the day You call me up
And until then, I'll follow You
And wait for that day to come
